name: Your Team (template)
description: TEMPLATE BEAT - Robert's sports vision (2026-08-31): follow ANY sports team and get custom AI shows about them. Copy this file per team (e.g. lakers.json), fill the slots, verify, pull, mine, show. Same machine, different plugs - proof the show-maker generalizes to sports.

show.name: THE HUDDLE
show.tagline: Your team, every day, like you were in the building

intro.template: Score/record check in one breath, then the day's biggest storyline as a topic card.

outro.template: Next game countdown + one bold prediction the comments can hold us to.

cases.title: The Season
cases.context: Standing case: playoff math, trade rumors, locker-room storylines. Fill per team.

_fill_guide: TWITTER: the team's official account, 2-3 beat writers (the local paper's team reporter), 1-2 credible fan/insider accounts. YOUTUBE: the team's channel, the local sports-radio station's channel, 1-2 team-focused creators. RSS: local paper's team feed + Google News RSS query for the team name.

rss.label: SLOT: Google News RSS for the team
rss.note: replace TEAM NAME; published feeds only, never hostile-crawl
